description:
Blood Donation camp at , 27 the October 2026 @ Goregaon Rly. Station ticket Office area of Goregaon West. Totally around 80 donors got registered but around 29 were rejected for the non compliance of medical parameters.

Heartiest congratulations to all of you on successful completion of Blood Donation Camp. We could collect 51 Blood bottles . Support by G T Hospital, staff and NSS unit
